task_summary: Repair run-length encoding in solution.py, document the public specification in a docstring, and add regression tests in test_solution.py.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace; edit solution.py and public tests.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library. Do not access parent repositories or external services.
Run-length encode adjacent equal strings as (value, count) pairs; nonadjacent equal values form separate runs; empty input returns [].
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections. No algorithmic complexity constraint is imposed.
test_solution.py must contain at least 3 passing unittest test methods exercising the public API.
Preserve all stated behavior and compatibility requirements.

success_criteria.description: The solution exposes a public specification docstring and the test file defines at least three unittest test methods.

check.command: python -c 'import ast; from pathlib import Path; solution = ast.parse(Path("solution.py").read_text()); tests = ast.parse(Path("test_solution.py").read_text()); assert ast.get_docstring(solution) or any(ast.get_docstring(node) for node in solution.body if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))); methods = [node for node in ast.walk(tests) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name.startswith("test")]; assert len(methods) >= 3'

success_criteria.description: The unittest suite is discoverable and passes.

verification.command: python -c 'import ast; from pathlib import Path; solution = ast.parse(Path("solution.py").read_text()); tests = ast.parse(Path("test_solution.py").read_text()); assert ast.get_docstring(solution) or any(ast.get_docstring(node) for node in solution.body if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))); methods = [node for node in ast.walk(tests) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name.startswith("test")]; assert len(methods) >= 3'

assumptions: The named files are interpreted as relative paths within the supplied task workspace; either file may not exist yet and may be created.
The public specification docstring may be placed at module, public API function, or public API class level because no exact location or public symbol name was specified.

The public API and its function name are not specified; tests should exercise the API implemented in solution.py without assuming an unstated name or behavior beyond the stated run-length encoding requirements.
The requested unittest discovery command is assumed to discover test_solution.py from the workspace root.
